partsNote: Quantities are shown exactly as recorded. “Used” is never inferred from “issued”: where the two are equal and nothing was returned, the figure may be the system default applied at hand-over.
legacyNote: Older records may lack some details (actor, time or quantities). Missing items are marked “Not recorded” and are never estimated.
